scope: Reserved 48-car test cohort, disjoint from the 420 training and 16 selection cars. No weights/statistics/hyperparameters fitted on these test results. Primary 25-setting completion average excludes the new unobserved diagnostic. Primary online comparison uses per-encoder LR fixed on old validation; same-rate alternatives are secondary. Architecture replicates vary upstream/head seeds with shared downstream sampling seed0. Three genuine downstream seeds apply to online, completion and frozen comparisons. Car-grouped intervals retain seeds and are descriptive, unadjusted. Same dataset/flow regime, not broad physical OOD or the HF 400/34/50 official split. Encoder pretraining corpora and normal inputs differ; no causal pretraining-objective attribution from encoder comparisons.
